title: Good idea but shelves won't hold lids
text: Good idea but shelves won't hold lids. This is not suited for it's purpose.  I'd rather have a five or four hole shelf that actually is deep enough for my lids.  I have NO idea what this one would work for but not one lid in a house with tons of water bottles and tumblers fits on these shelves.

product_metadata.title: YAJR Tumbler Lid Organizer, Bamboo Cup Lid Organizer for Cabinet, Water Bottle Lid Organizer, Vertical Lid Storage Organization for Kitchen Countertop/Cupboard
features: KITCHEN MUST HAVES - Tired of messy cabinets? Always have issues finding the lids? This tumbler lid organizer was designed to deal with an avalanche of cup tops when opening the cabinet. It keeps all of your tumbler lids in order and stores them in an appealing and premium way. No more lid clutter with removal from the front rather than top

ALL REGULAR CUP LIDS WELCOME - This kitchen lid storage solution was optimized for organizing lids of most common 10/20/30 oz stainless steel tumblers and generic tumbler lid replacement, but can work with any that has similar dimensions, including tumbler shield, acrylic tumbler toppers and other tumbler topper accessories smaller than 4 inches wide by 1 inch tall

IDEALLY SIZED - Measuring 5.6 X 5 X 9.75 inches, this cup lid storage rack takes up one large tumbler space in the corner of the cabinet. When fully loaded, it would hold 8 lids and blend nicely with a coffee bar organizer for countertop. Pair this with a water bottle organizer, coffee mug holder or other space saver kitchen organization and storage solutions that you might have

PURE NATURE AND EASY TO CLEAN - These coffee mug lid holders have been fully assembled and fabricated with 100% natural renewable bamboo. The surface is sanded and polished for a slick sheen. Simply wipe clean with a damp rag. Do not put in dishwasher or microwave
GREAT GIFT CHOICE - Know someone who loves keeping their kitchen neat and tidy? This simple compact tumbler lid holder will be sure to impress them on special occasions.
